王野想着学习厨艺的事情，也没有心思继续睡觉了，起身就出了门。今天是周末，也不知道何雨柱在不在家，王野出了家门就来到对门，对门的三大爷阎埠贵正在门口坐着。

王野上前打了声招呼：“闫老师，歇着呢？”

阎埠贵笑呵呵的说：“王野呀，来我们院子有什么事儿吗？”

王野：“我找柱子哥有点事儿。”

“傻柱呀，用我带你进去吗？”

王野可知道，这位三大爷，可是雁过拔毛的铁公鸡瓷鹌鹑，出了名的无利不起早，想让他帮忙，那可是必须出点血的。王野就说：“不用麻烦闫老师了，我认识路。“说完不等阎埠贵答话就进了院门。

王野进门，直接就穿过前院直奔中院，王野记得何雨柱家住在中院的正房，东厢房住着易中海，西厢房住着贾家。到了中院，正好看见贾东旭的媳妇秦淮茹正在洗衣服，前世看电视剧的时候，王野就想过，这贾家有多少衣服呀，天天洗。

贾张氏正在门口纳鞋底，也不知道给谁做鞋，天天在那儿摆摆样子，就是贾东旭也没穿过几次新鞋。贾张氏看见是王野，只是低头嘀咕了几句。

王野知道肯定不是什么好话，今天有正事儿，也就没有搭理这个老虔婆。贾东旭报复王野被反杀的事儿，贾张氏应该不知道，要不然又是一场大戏。

王野走到正房见房门关着，并没有上锁，就上前敲门，说：“柱子哥在家吗，我是王野？”

话音刚落，门就开了，何雨柱看见王野有点惊讶：“呦，王野兄弟呀，今儿怎么有空来找我了？”

“柱子哥，我找你有点儿事儿。”

何雨柱听见这话，赶紧让王野进门：“来来，兄弟，进屋说，正好哥哥在喝酒，咱俩一起喝点儿。”

看着桌上一盘花生米，半瓶二锅头，王野心想，这时的何雨柱还没有被秦慧茹吸血，凭他的手艺，再加上就他和妹妹何雨水，两人生活还算不错，王野顺着何雨柱也就坐下了。

何雨柱拿了一个小酒盅，给王野倒了一杯，端起自己的酒，说：“兄弟，咱是第一次坐在一起，先走一个，今天也是赶巧了，改天哥哥给你好好做俩菜，让你尝尝哥哥的手艺。”

两人喝了一杯后，何雨柱又给王野倒满。这时王野开口了：“柱子哥，听说你的家传手艺是谭家菜是吗？”

“对呀！我爹当年是谭家菜的大厨，从小我就学的是谭家菜，后来去了丰泽园当学徒，又学了鲁菜和川菜。”

“柱子哥厉害呀！人家学一样就不容易了，你这学三样。”

何雨柱“嘿嘿”笑了两声说：“别看他们都叫我傻柱，但是哥哥一点都不傻，虽然学别的东西不行，但是说到厨艺，不是哥哥吹，我就是看看别人做菜，就能学个八九不离十。”

“那柱子哥真是天生的大厨呀！”

“兄弟要说厨艺，别看哥哥不大，四九城里除了那些老头子，就哥哥的手艺绝对排的上号。”

两人又闲聊了几句，王野就开始说正事了：“柱子哥，你知道满汉全席吗？”

何雨柱听见这话，双眼瞪得老大说：“兄弟呀，那哪个厨子不知道满汉全席呀！只是现在大家不敢提了。”

王野继续说：“柱子哥，我也不跟你卖关子，我前段时间得到了一套满汉全席的菜谱，但是呢，我又不会厨艺。我想着咱兄弟取长补短，你教教厨艺，我把满汉全席的菜谱给你抄一份，这样咱们各取所需共同进步。”

何雨柱听了王野的话，有点迟疑说：“兄弟，不是哥哥不想教你，只是我爹当时跟我说，我家这手艺不外传...”

王野也不气馁，就说：“柱子哥，我也没说让你现在就教我。你可以问问你家我大爷，我呢，有自己的工作，也不会去把厨艺当成谋生的手段，只是想满足自己的口腹之欲。”

“兄弟，，你不知道，我和我爹已经好几年没联系了，我也不想找他。”

Wang Ye was thinking about learning cooking skills and had no intention of continuing to sleep. He got up and went out.Today is the weekend, and I don't know if He Yuzhu is at home. Wang Ye walked out of the house and came to the opposite door. The third uncle Yan Bugui was sitting at the door.

Wang Ye stepped forward and said hello: "Teacher Yan, are you having a rest?"

Yan Bugui said with a smile: "Wang Ye, what's the matter with coming to our yard?"

Wang Ye: "I have something to do with Brother Zhuzi."

"Silly Zhu, do you want me to take you in?"

Wang Ye knew that this third uncle was like a porcelain quail whose feathers were plucked, and he was notoriously unprofitable. If he wanted his help, some blood would have to be shed.Wang Ye said, "Don't bother Teacher Yan, I know the way." After saying that, he entered the courtyard without waiting for Yan Bugui's reply.

Wang Ye walked in and walked directly through the front yard to the middle yard. Wang Ye remembered that He Yuzhu's family lived in the main house of the middle yard, Yi Zhonghai lived in the east wing, and the Jia family lived in the west wing.When he arrived at the middle courtyard, he happened to see Jia Dongxu's daughter-in-law Qin Huairu washing clothes. When he was watching TV series in his previous life, Wang Ye had thought about how many clothes the Jia family had and they would wash them every day.

Mrs. Jia Zhang was collecting shoe soles at the door. She didn’t know who she was making shoes for, so she showed off there every day. Even Jia Dongxu didn’t wear new shoes a few times.When Jia Zhang saw it was Wang Ye, she just lowered her head and muttered a few words.

Wang Ye knew it was definitely not a nice thing to say. He had business to do today, so he ignored the old pious woman.Jia Zhang should not know about Jia Dongxu's revenge against Wang Ye for being killed, otherwise it would be another big drama.

Wang Ye walked to the main room and saw that the door was closed and unlocked, so he knocked on the door and said, "Brother Zhuzi is at home? I am Wang Ye?"

As soon as he finished speaking, the door opened. He Yuzhu was a little surprised to see Wang Ye: "Hey, brother Wang Ye, why are you free to come see me today?"

"Brother Zhuzi, I have something to do with you."

He Yuzhu heard this and quickly asked Wang Ye to come in: "Come on, brother, come into the room and say, brother happens to be drinking, let's have some drinks together."

Looking at a plate of peanuts and half a bottle of Erguotou on the table, Wang Ye thought that He Yuzhu had not been sucked by Qin Huiru at this time. With his skills, plus the fact that he and his sister He Yuu were living a pretty good life, Wang Ye followed He Yuzhu and sat down.

He Yuzhu took a small wine cup, poured a glass for Wang Ye, picked up his own wine, and said: "Brother, this is the first time for us to sit together, one of us will leave first. Today is a coincidence. Another day, my brother will cook two dishes for you, so that you can have a taste of my brother's cooking."

After the two drank a glass, He Yuzhu refilled Wang Ye's glass.At this time Wang Ye spoke: "Brother Zhuzhu, I heard that your family's cooking is Tan's cuisine, right?"

"Yes! My father was the chef of Tan's cuisine back then. I have been learning Tan's cuisine since I was a child. Later, I went to Fengzeyuan as an apprentice and learned Shandong cuisine and Sichuan cuisine."

"Brother Zhuzi is amazing! It's not easy for others to learn one thing, but you learn three things."

He Yuzhu laughed twice and said, "Even though they all call me Silly Zhu, my brother is not stupid at all. Although I can't learn other things, when it comes to cooking, it's not my brother who is good at it. I can learn almost everything by just watching others cook."

"Brother Zhuzhu is really a born chef!"

"Brothers, when it comes to cooking skills, don't look at my elder brother. Apart from those old men in Sijiu City, my brother's cooking skills are definitely ranked high."

The two chatted for a while, and then Wang Ye got down to business: "Brother Zhuzhu, do you know about the Man-Han Banquet?"

When He Yuzhu heard this, his eyes widened and he said, "Brother, what cook doesn't know about the Man-Han Banquet! It's just that no one dares to mention it now."

Wang Ye continued: "Brother Zhuzi, I won't lie to you. I got a set of recipes for the Manchu-Han Banquet some time ago, but I don't know how to cook. I thought that we brothers would learn from each other's strengths and you would teach us how to cook. I will give you a copy of the Man-Han Banquet recipe, so that we can each learn what we need and make progress together."

After hearing Wang Ye's words, He Yuzhu hesitated and said: "Brother, it's not that I don't want to teach you, it's just that my father told me at the time that my family's craftsmanship should not be passed on to others..."

Wang Ye was not discouraged and said: "Brother Zhuzi, I didn't ask you to teach me now. You can ask your uncle. As for me, I have my own job and I don't use cooking as a means of making a living. I just want to satisfy my appetite."

"Brother, you don't know, I haven't contacted my father for several years, and I don't want to find him."
